problem:
Title: Sum of Complex Integrals on Adjacent Intervals

Let $\closedint a b$ be a [[Definition:Closed Real Interval|closed real interval]].

Let $f: \closedint a b \to \C$ be a [[Definition:Continuous Complex Function|continuous complex function]].

Let $c \in \closedint a b$.

Then:

:$\ds \int_a^c \map f t \rd t + \int_c^b \map f t \rd t = \int_a^b \map f t \rd t$
